answer: Unique Context Carryover Ledger: each agent identity inherits a random 256-bit state from its first action; every subsequent action must consume and hash that state with fresh input, and peers reject repeated states as forks. An attacker cloning identities hits the same constraint as a meadow after rain: each copy needs distinct costly interactions to grow a viable thread of history. Duplicate roots are pruned before any plume of reputation forms, forcing one real interaction per identity.
